cohort: 4646 pregnant women who underwent oral glucose tolerance tests between 24 and 32 weeks of gestation and gave birth at the Clinical Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Zagreb University Hospital Center, between 2013 and 2015
finding: The study found that underweight, overweight, and obese women, as well as those with excessive gestational weight gain, had an increased risk of maternal and neonatal complications.
